resources.name: Periodic DFT software with CI-NEB (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO, CP2K, or VASP)

access.notes: Open-source DFT code supporting periodic calculations, PBE functional, DFT-D3, and CI-NEB. VASP with VTST is also acceptable if a license is available.
Standard solid-state pseudopotentials library; essential for DFT calculations.
Standalone code or built-in support in many DFT packages; needed to include dispersion forces.
